what_it_is.quote: net.exe or net1.exe adding a local user.

esql.query: from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where (ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\net.exe") or ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\net1.exe")) and process.command_line like "*user*" and process.command_line like "*/add*"

kql.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where (FolderPath endswith "\\net.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\net1.exe") and (ProcessCommandLine contains "user" and ProcessCommandLine contains "/add")

title: Local account added from the command line
triage_tips: Compare with the helpdesk change calendar.
Known false positive: helpdesk scripts for lab machines.
Check Image is net.exe or net1.exe and read the CommandLine for the user and /add.
what_it_is: Process-creation rule that detects net.exe or net1.exe adding a local user from the command line.
why_it_flags: Image ends with net.exe or net1.exe and the CommandLine contains both "user" and "/add". Tagged persistence, T1136.001; level medium.
